exposure: Interval TL by laparoscopy (LS) in the postpartum period
TL at the time of cesarean delivery (CD)
Timing of TL (at CD vs. interval LS)
Postpartum tubal ligation (TL) at the time of cesarean delivery (CD)
outcome: Ovarian reserve, as measured by anti-müllerian hormone (AMH) levels
cohort: 81 women desiring TL as a contraceptive method at the end of pregnancy
finding: Both TL at the time of CD and interval sterilization with LS have similar effects on ovarian reserve, with significant decreases in AMH levels observed in both groups.
mod_finding: Tubal ligation performed at the time of cesarean delivery and as a laparoscopic interval procedure in the postpartum period have similar effects on ovarian reserve.
